title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for eccentricity must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The total energy after the explosion must be correctly expressed in terms of initial energy and mass loss.

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The angular momentum before and after the explosion must be correctly identified as conserved.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The variables K, K', M, and M' must be correctly defined and used throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors related to sign mistakes in energy calculations must be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units should be consistently applied throughout the calculations to ensure dimensional correctness.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or special scenarios should be discussed to enhance understanding.
